text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a farmer.
source_text: You see a farmer.

text: Hi there, stranger. Like my crops?
source_text: Hi there, stranger. Like my crops?

text: Good morning to you!
source_text: Good morning to you!

text: Good afternoon!
source_text: Good afternoon!

text: Evening, friend!
source_text: Evening, friend!

text: Nice day, isn't it?
source_text: Nice day, isn't it?

text: This soil is much healthier than it looks.
source_text: This soil is much healthier than it looks.

text: I'm trying to save these trees and I think it's working.
source_text: I'm trying to save these trees and I think it's working.

text: There should be a fertilizer caravan.  Now there's some money.
source_text: There should be a fertilizer caravan.  Now there's some money.

text: Come on in, there's plenty of room.
source_text: Come on in, there's plenty of room.

text: It's a little chilly out there; have a seat.
source_text: It's a little chilly out there; have a seat.

text: Farming suits me.
source_text: Farming suits me.

text: Did you know plants grow better when you're nice to them?
source_text: Did you know plants grow better when you're nice to them?

text: I wish I had a little more land.
source_text: I wish I had a little more land.

text: Did you know there used to be large bodies of drinkable water?
source_text: Did you know there used to be large bodies of drinkable water?

text: I've read about rivers. I sure wish I had one next to my fields.
source_text: I've read about rivers. I sure wish I had one next to my fields.

text: I wish the days were longer; there's so much to do.
source_text: I wish the days were longer; there's so much to do.

text: 你看见一个农夫。
source_text: 你看见一个农夫。

text: 嗨，你好！陌生人。喜欢我的庄稼吗？
source_text: 嗨，你好！陌生人。喜欢我的庄稼吗？

text: 早上好啊！
source_text: 早上好啊！

text: 下午好啊！
source_text: 下午好啊！

text: 朋友，晚上好！
source_text: 朋友，晚上好！

text: 天气不错啊！
source_text: 天气不错啊！

text: 这土壤要比看起来肥沃好多。
source_text: 这土壤要比看起来肥沃好多。

text: 我尽力保护这些树，我想还有效果。
source_text: 我尽力保护这些树，我想还有效果。

text: 那应该有卖肥料的商队。还有一些钱。
source_text: 那应该有卖肥料的商队。还有一些钱。

text: 进来吧！那儿有宽裕的房间。
source_text: 进来吧！那儿有宽裕的房间。

text: 外面有点冷的：请坐。
source_text: 外面有点冷的：请坐。

text: 我就适合种地。
source_text: 我就适合种地。

text: 你知道你对它们越好它们长得也越好吗？
source_text: 你知道你对它们越好它们长得也越好吗？

text: 我希望能多那么一点地。
source_text: 我希望能多那么一点地。

text: 你知道哪里曾经有大量的饮用水吗？
source_text: 你知道哪里曾经有大量的饮用水吗？

text: 我在书上看到过大河。我真想在我的地旁边就有这么一条。
source_text: 我在书上看到过大河。我真想在我的地旁边就有这么一条。

text: 我希望一天过的再长些：那我就可以做更多的事情了。
source_text: 我希望一天过的再长些：那我就可以做更多的事情了。
